title: Skip-the-Line Tour of the Vatican, Sistine Chapel & St. Peter's | Small Group
description: If you’re not sure what you’re looking for, you can easily spend a day getting lost in the Vatican in Rome—not ideal if you’ve got limited time in Italy. Ensure you only see the best of the Vatican, and save hours waiting in line, on a skip-the-line tour that also includes access to St. Peter’s Basilica. Plus, a small group limited to 12 means you receive personalized attention.

reviews.usertext:
Our visit to the Vatican museums, Sistine Chapel, and St. Peter’s Basilica was a truly magical and unique experience. We are so happy we got a tour and even happier that Carlotta was our guide. From the beginning of the tour, she was a delight with a great sense of humor. She is also extremely knowledgeable and confident in the information she provides. Without her guidance, we would’ve been lost since there is so much to see. She guided us through the rooms and seamlessly related the pieces together and wove an engaging story. She also did a great job presenting the history of Michelangelo and the Sistine Chapel so that by the time we arrived at the Sistine Chapel, we had the background to appreciate Michelangelo’s huge accomplishment.
You can tell she is really passionate about what she teaches and we are thankful for her expertise. I really recommend that if you are visiting the Vatican, you book a tour to help guide you through all the rooms and explain the historical context of everything.

Prior to our first visit to Rome, we booked our semi private guided tour tickets of the Vatican in advance. There were so many to choose from it was a bit of a stab in the dark but What A Life Tours did not disappoint, couldn’t recommend them enough!! Arriving at the meeting point we were greeted with the warmest of welcomes and once the rest of our group arrived (just 3 other people) we set off on our Vatican adventure with Marco. Marco is Roman born and bred and is full of knowledge not only of the Vatican museums, Sistine Chapel & St Peters Basilica but of the city in general. He is clearly extremely passionate about what he does and we were hooked on his every word from from the very start right to the end. Marco is so engaging and managed to keep all members of the group gripped, from 2 children to 3 adults! He brought humour to the tour, he was willing to answer all our questions, he went above and beyond and brought us what felt like the true VIP treatment. 100% amazing value for money, could not recommend enough and have been on a high after this tour ever since!! Thank you What A Life Tours & Marco!

What a day we had yesterday with What a Life Tours going round the Vatican Basilica, the Museums and the Sistine Chapel. If you want to do this trio, then in our opinion, you simply have to take a guide in order to get round in an organised and efficient way, but also to receive valuable insights into what you are seeing. The queue for the Vatican is also very long indeed and the guide allows you to skip all the waiting and is very much worth the money when you have 4 people including teenagers. All of the Vatican sights are amazing, Elaine our guide was so knowledgeable about the Basilica that it made this part of the tour particularly informative. The huge scale of the monument is such a reality check when you get inside. The whole tour just builds and builds as you enter the Vatican museums, each one completely spell binding. The map rooms and the Raphael rooms are breath taking in their decoration, art and thematic depictions. Our guide Elaine made the whole 4 hour tour very enjoyable and entertaining with her knowledge and she also knew that your senses are taking in so much, that you also need some light hearted humour and jokes along the way. The whole tour finishes with the greatest man made thing I have ever seen in my life - the Sistine Chapel. If you have seen pictures of this before you go in, we’ll, nothing can prepare you for the enormous impact this masterpiece has on your soul. Just thinking about the individual, personal sacrifice Michelangelo made in order to deliver this to the world alters your perception of purpose. I am typical bloke who loves watching and playing sport, not given over to exaggeration etc. This experience was like an earthquake.

I took this tour September 6th, the tour was supposed to start at 9am so we can get ahead of the crowds in the morning, I was notified the day before that the tour was being delayed one hour to 10am, in my mind it defeated the purpose of booking an early morning tour to beat the crowds. The tour guide did a good job of explaining what we were looking at but missed many of the key items that I overheard other guides explaining to their groups. The museum tour of the Sistine chapel, maps, and tapestries was at capacity with spectators, we were shoulder to shoulder in the crowd, with way too many people to really enjoy what you are looking at. Tour rushed through many of the rooms, too quick to really appreciate what you are looking at. All in all, I would recommend coming in the off months and booking an earlier time or later afternoon time to avoid the crowds so you can really enjoy the beauty of the various museums.

The places we visited on the tour were amazing to look at and we would definitely recommend visiting all three (vatican museum, Sistine Chapel and St. Peters Basilica), but we felt the tour was very rushed. Our tour guide (Laura) rushed ahead a lot and spoke very quickly, so it was hard to understand all the history behind everything, which was a bit disappointing.
Be prepared for ques and very big crowds, you don't get much chance to view things.

I booked the small group tour so that my wife and I would have a more intimate tour with less people. It cost us $164.04 USD for the both of us. We were paired with our tour guide Elaine. She was wonderful. She definitely had a lot of knowledge to share with us. Where our tour went bad was right after finishing the Sistine Chapel. We walked a bit to the entrance of St. Peter's Basilica. There was a fountain where we could fill our water bottles to which Elaine indicated we could fill up. We waited in line to fill up and when my wife and I were finished, we looked around, and couldn't find our group. We looked around the area, and couldn't find them. We decided to search even further so one of us stayed back in the hopes that Elaine would come back and find us. Our search came up short. Our last effort was to message the company to let them know. I had two different ways to contact them, but we didn't receive a response until 40 minutes later. We waited at the water fountain for a total of 30 minutes before deciding to call it quits. We walked to the Company's office to let them know what happened. The gentleman there offered me a $20 refund. I was a bit disappointed because we had paid quite a bit for the tour. He then proceeds to tell me that Elaine had been looking for us even though we stayed at the place she lost us. The gentleman then gives me a $50 refund which is better than $20, but I intimately would've preferred to have had my tour. I don't understand how someone gets forgotten in a "Small Group Tour."

We had a long holiday weekend in Rome and booked primarily to expedite the lines but the tour far surpassed our expectations and I would highly recommend anyone traveling here for the first time use an experienced guide. Elaine was brilliant and her knowledge and passion for the city's art and history was genuine and enthusiastic. In the three days we've been here we've fallen in love with Rome and Elaine helped us appreciate the richness of it's history and why it's a city I will want to revisit again and again.

Highly recommend getting this tour guided as we learned so much from our guide! Very informative and a well planned tour when there is so much to see. It really nice having a streamlined experience of a crowded place like the Vatican, our guide executed our visit perfectly! He knew what to highlight and when to hit each place. Highly recommend getting a skip the line pass too for the Vatican Museums - well worth it to breeze right in. Although you have to wait in the normal line for St Peter’s, it’s not too bad. Just go as early in the morning as you can. Don’t skimp, get the guide!

Selected tour for max of 12 people. Elaine was our guide and all started well. Was knowledgeable but at times tried being a comedian with a rehearsed script to get laughs.

Granted there were thousands of people on tours today but still the responsibility not to lose their clients considering there were only 12 of us. One hour into your my wife, myself and two other adult ladies were separated from the group. We hadn’t wandered off but just seperate did and never to be found by our guide the rest of the trip. Elaine should pay more attention and less time trying to be a comedian.

On a positive note we stopped another guide named Manuela from the same tour company. Explained our situation and she had us join her group. She was smart, knowledgeable and kept a close eye on her entire group including us. She couldn’t have been nicer .

Recommend trying yo get Manuela and forget Elaine just like she forgot the four of us,

We found the start location quite easily at a local café, our guide was very friendly and was considerate to get us to Saint Peters earlier than the crowd so we could have a look around in relative peace. Then we were given the audio tour and onto The Sistine chapel via the museum, this was very crowded and very hot this time of year but our guide made it as comfortable as possible. Would recommend this Tour, ideally at a cooler time of year.

It was a really great tour. We started in the museum. It wasn't rushed, but you could definitely have spent another 2 hours going through it. Our guide has lots of insights for the items and we were able to get through it without having to read every sign. We then went through the Sistine chapel. The guides aren't allowed to talk through that and if we used our phones to look something up they told us not to take photos. They gave us a printout with labels, but I wish we would have spent a bit more time beforehand studying some of the painting so we knew what to do look for.
We then did the basilica, which was beautiful and massive. Our tour guide was amazing. She spoke english well, had lots of insight, answered questions, and was a delight to be around. She was our favorite tour guide for the entire trip.

Our tour guide, Tony, was awesome! He was friendly, funny, and made the tour very interesting and entertaining! I’m so happy I booked the afternoon tour because per our guide, it’s a much better experience than the morning tours because there are less people and you can actually have space to enjoy yourself. We even got to witness the changing of the guards at the Vatican! Tony also let us know what the good picture spots were and even offered to take our pictures. The tour was worth every dollar and it was nice to be able to learn about the Vatican, Sistine Chapel, and St. Peter’s Basilica from someone who is knowledgeable, rather than trying to tour through these places on your own. Highly recommend to anyone looking to make the most of their visit to these places!

The sites were incredible and highly recommend seeing The Vatican, Sistine Chapel and St Peters. However, our tour guide was a bit disappointing- he would go off on tangents and never come back to the initial conversation. Seemed he focused on one particular Pope verses offering broader educational experiences for the group on history, events, and even specifics. We noticed inside St Peters there was a way to view the tombs downstairs, but he never mentioned it for us to explore on our own after the tour.

Manuela was an amazing tour guide and the Vatican museum was the best art I have ever seen please don’t miss it. It did last for over 3 incredible hours so i would not recommend for younger children or those who cannot walk for that long. Thank you Manuela!!

Eugene was a great and knowledgeable tour guide. He took our small group all over Vatican Square, St. Peter’s Basilica, and the Sistine Chapel and sprinkled some humor into his educational tour as well. He made sure we were all accounted for each time we had to pause for other groups or obtaining radios. He is a fantastic guide and we highly recommend getting a tour with him!

This was a great tour. Our guide Lara was knowlegable, informative and totally on top of her subject. She led us quickly through the bottleneck areas and the 3 hours just flew passed. I was so pleased that we booked with Skip the Line tours and am happy to thoroughly recommend this company to anyone wishing to get the best from the Vatican city experience.

My friend and I booked with What a Life Tours. This was an amazing experience! Our guide was wonderful...an English guy with great knowledge of the Vatican. It was really crowded and he did a great job of keeping us together and giving us a ton of information about St Peters and Vatican Museum. It's a good idea to take extra water on this walking tour. Once the tour ended...the museum went on for quite a distance. The gift vendors starting popping up near the end and then there's a huge gift shop and snack area at the end. It may be a good idea to plan a little extra time after the tour. We wanted to walk back around to St Peters Sq again...it's just amazing!

Our tour guide, Elaine, really made this tour for us. Her unique sense of humour and her astonishing recall of facts about just about everything made this a tour to remember. Would really recommend this company and this guide to anyone hoping to visit the Vatican in the near future and it’s worth pointing out that tours get in before the general population!

Book this tour! Our guide knew all the “ins-and-outs” of the Vatican and his expertise in art history was fantastic. We toured on Easter Saturday. The crowds were tremendous. Yet our guide’s familiarity allowed us to see the sites effortlessly. In fact, he clearly knew some of the security people at the Vatican Museum, resulting in our being directly lead from big queues inside the museum directly to the highlights. In fact, his relationships with some of the curators got us a bonus visit to the Vatican necropolis. Highly recommended. These folks know their way around and then some!

The best reason for a guided tour is to make sure you hit all the highlights on what might be your only visit ever. Our tour was three hours, and we really kind of skimmed the museum, focusing on the most important items and hearing the history of them from our guide, Lucia. An engaging and knowledgeable guide, she brings the place to life! Audioguides are boring - a LIVE guide imparts their own enthusiasm and can answer your questions, making a nice visit so much better. The Sistine Chapel is gorgeous of course. We found it hilarious that you're not allowed to speak (good luck with that) or take pictures (oh, sure), and every few minutes this huge booming voice comes over the loudspeaker telling everyone that SILENCE IS REQUIRED. Anyway, the tour was great, and I'm glad we had our guide in St. Peters, too. So much history, and it's just overwhelming without someone to point out the fantastic trivia and interesting tidbits, as well as the do-not-miss items.

Don't hesitate to book with What a Life Tours! This Skip-the-Line tour in particular was well worth it.

If you are lucky, you'll get Elaine. She was a wonderful and incredibly informed guide. She took an extremely large museum (The Vatican Museum is one of the largest in the world) and made it efficient, fun, and worthwhile. She knew where to go, never missed a step, and had all kinds of wonderful trivia, jokes, and information handy. She had palpable respect for the art, religion, and history. You could tell this was an important place for her.

The early breakfast ( a cappuccino and cornetto) is a nice touch ahead of much walking. You'll meet your group after breakfast. You'll get to the Vatican early and pretty quickly.

You don't want to explore the Vatican without a tour. It gets very crowded so a guide is crucial for navigation. And there is a lot of art and history that just needs context to fully appreciate.

The groups are small. I had about 12 people in my group and felt a sense of camaraderie after spending most of the day with them. We saw several large groups from other companies go by and I felt fortunate to have chosen What a Life.

My tour guide Elaine was by far the best guide I have ever had in my travels. She was so professional and knowledgeable. She knew a lot of little insider tidbits that even other guides are not aware of. If you are thinking about doing an English speaking guided tour I highly recommend choosing What A Life Tours and Especially with Elaine as your guide.

The Tour is not cheap but as with so many things you get what you pay for!
I cannot fault this organisation. The communication beforehand was first class, minimising any mistakes about being at the right place at the right time.
There were 11 in our group which made movement through the museums, the Sistine Chapel and St Peters pretty seamless.
The best feature of the 3 hours was our guide, Marco. His knowledge was phenomenal, no questions remained unanswered, he interacted with us all and did so with humour. The time flew by even when there was a little necessary queuing.
I tend to like to find my own way round places I am visiting, Marco made me think again.

We had an amazing tour guided by Daniela. She did a great job of explaining all of the history behind the art pieces and Vatican itself, and also making our visit enjoyable and smooth despite the huge crowds in the Vatican museums and Sistine Chapel. I would recommend this tour to everyone!

Tony was highly knowledgeable, delightfully engaging and well practiced in reading the movement of the tour groups through the inevitable bottlenecks like a sea captain bringing his ship safely through a treacherous harbour. Our tour was smooth, flowing and we had all the unspoilt photo opportunities given to us on a platter. Five star experience. Ten star guide. And skip the line is definitely the way to go. The lines were huge!

Our tour started with Elaine giving us some bad news: St. Peter's would be closed to tours that day because the Pope had decided the night before to use the church for it's intended purpose, mass! I was disappointed and wondered how we would fill the time that would have normally been given to touring the basilica. Looking back though, I'm not sure what I would have cut from the tour to make room for St. Peters! Elaine was full of jokes, facts, and witticisms and my disappointment was soon forgotten. She has a real passion for the subject and by the end of the tour I was grateful to have a tour guide as skilled as her (it helps that she has many Roman Secrets, which you'll have to do the tour to learn!). If I hear that a friend is going to Rome I will highly recommend What a Life Tours and Elaine as a tour guide.

We had Elaine for our tour guide. She was obviously very enthusiastic and knowledgeable about what she was showing us and talking about. Her passion for the subject was quite evident. She was very efficient and knew just how to mange the group through the crowds (very extensive crowds) and did all with just the right amount of humor thrown in. It was a very enjoyable experience that I would highly recommend.

Going with a smaller more intimate group was the definitely the right decision. Elaine was very knowledgeable and passionate about the Vatican history. Other groups were leaning over to try and listen to the extra tidbits she was sharing. Would highly recommend for anyone to use this group.

Our guide was awesome! Very Knowledgeable and helpful throughout the tour! You’ll be able to learn a lot and really understand what you’re looking at with this tour.

I would advise you to make sure there aren’t any special events happening at the Vatican before you book your date. I originally bought this ticket and paid the premium in order to skip the line; however, due to a mass being held at the Vatican we could not skip the line. The Vatican has a calendar on their website (I didn’t know this before), please double check before choosing a date.

Without booking this tour - getting into St. Peter’s Basilica is free and getting into the Vatican Museums is 17 euro.

Tonia was our guide through the Vatican and she was fantastic. She was super knowledgable about everything we saw and kept it very entertaining. On top of teaching us about all of the art and the history of the buildings themselves, she also knew how to navigate through the crowds very well. No matter when you go it will be crowded at the Vatican, but with Tonia you will move efficiently through the crowds and will avoid the worst of it.

Manuela was an outstanding English-speaking tour guide! She had excellent pacing and the tour guide ended at St. Peter's where we could split off and explore on our own. In addition to her extensive knowledge, the best part was just seeing how passionate she was for the art and construction. Even when I asked her about a more obscure section of the Sistine Chapel, she was able to immediately give me a great answer. Would highly recommend this tour group and Manuela specifically!

What a fantastic tour this was. Really the best we have ever taken. Tour guide Daniela was superb, an art historian with extensive knowledge, a clear command of English and a delightful sense of humor. The Vatican Museum was overwhelming, certainly one of the world's greatest and by the time we reached the Sistine Chapel, that magnificent ceiling seemed "ordinary." St Peter's is simply a testament to what man is capable of. Bottom line - don't hesitate to sign up with this tour company. If our tour was any indication of the quality you can expect you will not be disappointed. A+

We used What a Life Tours and our Guide was Elaine! She was the best tour guide we’ve ever had! She kept the tour moving and filled us with so much information we would have never learned touring on our own. A small group tour is the way to go. She was able to answer every question the group asked and even answered some questions for people not in our group! It’s very obvious she loves her job and wants everyone to enjoy their day- wanting us all to walk away knowing much more than when we started! Thank you so much Elaine you made our day special.

Truly truly I do not want to go to a museum without Eugenes insightful commentary and expertise. His eye and knowledge of history and the arts meant that he knew exactly where to draw the eye, and what the most fascinating pieces in the room were. He also had an iPad with some imagery to build the backstory behind some art pieces that I would have walked past without a thought. None of my husbands questions could stump him, and he also had a very charming wit about him that made the pacing of the tour feel relaxed but full. (No rushed feeling or no feeling like someone was reading an encyclopedia to us) I am so glad we chose to do this tour, a lot of tours will end at the Vatican basilica, but this ended in the museum so that we could admire the Sistine chapel as long as we liked, and revisit some of our favorite museum art pieces.

Nice, fun informative tour. Our guide Manuela provided an informative commentary as we traversed the various areas of the Vatican. She was so easy to understand and follow. She knew the little details that make a tour fun and educational. I'm glad we took this tour. The smaller group size was perfect....a larger group would have been a drag.

Our guide was Elaine.
Elaine was very knowledgeable and entertaining throughout and has taken the time to learn her trade which is reflected in her passion for this tour.
The tour was very interesting and meant we maximised our time and learnt more about the Vatican and St Peters.
Would recommend these skip the line tours saving a lot of time and wondering what you are looking at.

Excellent tour, guide, and experience. Though the lines we skipped were not as long as I had feared/anticipated, it still made for a nice expedite entry process and some assurance that we wouldn’t waste our valuable time in line. Our guide was excellent, providing great insight throughout the tour. Given the size of the Vatican museum it’s not possible to see it all on a tour like this, but enough to give you a taste and introduction. Plenty of time was given in the Sistine Chapel to admire it’s beauty, the shortcut to St. Peter’s save use more time, and the tour ended with use in St. Peter’s left to explore at our leisure (after a great guided tour of the highlights before ending the official part of the tour). Absolutely recommended if you are short on time, want something structured, and seeking a quality guide.

Tonia, our guide, was absolutely brilliant. She was so knowledgeable about everything and gave us time to absorb and take in the magnificent St Peter’s Basilica and the Vatican museum.

Our only criticism about the tour was the Sistine Chapel. It was supposed to be a place of silence. People were talking and you felt ushered through by security. Announcements were made all the time to be silent, not take photos etc. Suggest large notices as you enter or have timed entries to ensure this happens.

Also the ear pieces ‘over the ear’ were uncomfortable for three of our party as would not stay on.

Tonia was just brilliant though and please pass on our thanks.

My family have used What a Life Tours many times while travelling to Italy, we were so happy to hear they survived through the pandemic.
Once again, we had an excellent tour of the Vatican with Manuela! She is amazing, her ability to keep us interested in a 3/3.5 hour tour was outstanding. The Vatican is crowded, do your self a favour, and hire a good guide to help you understand the history of the Museums. Very organized staff members, Maria and Joseph were very helpful in their office, keep up the good job!! Grazi

From the first five minutes of the tour, our guide Elaine was filling our heads with facts about the city and places of interest. Elaine’s attention to detail was fantastic as we wondered around St Peter’s Basilica before making our way to the Vatican museum and finally through the Sistine chapel. Our favourite was St Peter’s Basilica. A must see. Thank-you once again Elaine. See you soon Rome.

Gabriel was an extraordinary guide. His knowledge was infinite he gave very clear stories about the art and archaeological information. We went beyond what we as expected in every way and took us through extra rooms and galleries when it was possible. I can’t imagine a better guide!

Elaine was wonderful and the whole tour of the Vatican museum, Sistine chapel, and St. Peter’s Basilica was excellent. Elaine was captivating and kept me engaged the whole time, which says a lot because I often have a hard time following guides. She was very easy to hear and follow throughout the entire tour. The Vatican museum is huge and wouldn’t be worth it without a great tour guide like Elaine- she pointed out things that made my visit so much more worthwhile. The small group of only 12 people was perfect and I also didn’t wait in any lines despite the crowds. The quality of this tour is so much better than any others I’ve done. I am so happy I did this tour and have already recommended this company to family and friends!

An amazing way to see the Vatican. Our guide Manuela was extremely knowledgable, funny, and friendly. She was able to take a museum, bring the history to life, and explain the "why" of the many artifacts and art in a way that made everything very interesting. The Sistine Chapel is incredible, even more so when the why and most especially the how is shared. Our group was relatively small with only 8 ppl and we ewer able to skip the lines. My wife and I absolutely loved this tour and would highly recommend it.

Elaine was absolutely fantastic. As i was telling my partner, there are tour guides who are in it for the money, and others who are in it for the love for what they do. And Elaine loves what she does, her storytelling, ettiquete and humor is refereshing and genuinely entertaining. Highly Hghly Recommend

This was a very thorough tour, led by a knowledgeable and amiable guide. The small group of about 12 people was worth the extra money. We would have preferred a native born English speaker because English spoken rapidly by an Italian was sometimes difficult to understand through average quality headphones. It is also a rather long tour with lots of steep crowded steps which may be hard for those elderly or less fit.

The Vatican Tour with john was fantastic. I highly recommend signing up with this company. Very professional, very courteous from beginning to end.

John has been a tour guide for over 30 years and his knowledge of the Vatican history and the art displayed is impressive.

Highly recommended!

What a great experience!!! Since I have been a kid I have wanted to see the Sistine Chapel and just stare at the fresco painted by Michelangelo. It's very fulfilling, and our tour guide (who has a Ph' D) gave us a very nice visual rundown of the painting. Felt fulfilled. I can't remember the name of the Tour guide (thanks jet lag) but she spoke English well and was highly educated. I would try to ask for her.

Im left speechless from this tour. There were so many things to look at and learn about. Our guide was extremely knowledgeable about all three destinations: Vatican museums, Sistine Chapel & St.Peter’s Basilica. I would definitely take an extensive tour with him if possible. There is only so much you can do within the 3 hours. I can only imagine what else I can learn from a day long tour. The experience was truly breath taking. There is an overload of information here and having a great guide is essential for that. After the tour, we were allowed back inside to attend a live mass! I recommend being physically prepared for this tour. Wearing sandals was not very smart.

This was an excellent tour which, although covering the highlights of the Vatican, felt very comprehensive. Before the tour, who runs What a Life Tours, provided us with all the info we needed and then contacted us beforehand to rearrange our tour due to an unexpected closure of St Peter's Basilica which was much appreciated. Our tour guide on the day was Elaine who was both knowledgeable and very enthusiastic - an ideal combination. She was also clear and concise with her instructions which allowed us to move through the many security areas with consumate ease. Having only 8 people in our group also gave the experience a more intimate feel. Elaine gave us lots of insights that we would never have gained on our own and we never felt hurried or overwhelmed. The fours hours flew by.

I couldn't enter St.Pietro because I was late due to a taxi drivers' sudden strike (it turned out I couldn't enter anyway for it was Wednesday morning when the Pope has a regular mass), but enjoyed the rest of the tour, mainly the 1st half of Vatican Museum (culminated in the Last Judgement in Sistine Chapel). It may not be appropriate for those who want to take time to see deeply into the treasures in this gigantic museum (you may need at least a full day to do it, I suppose), but it perfectly fits for a first-time visitor who wants to see the most important works that tell us the blessed history of Rome/Vatican and the heritage of Catholic church. The guide (sorry I didn't ask his name) was a very joyful, fluent storyteller, telling some interesting backdoor stories about the historical works and Roman relics.

Tonia was truly fantastic! We had a small group and she clearly knew her stuff. We received important and interesting information on history, art, religion, culture and politics. Tonia used humor and knowledge to make the 3 hours fly by! She was skilled in moving us through the crowded areas, so the tour was as relaxed as possible. We highly recommend this tour, especially if you can have Tonia!!

This was the best guided tour the entire time we were in Italy! Manuela was a fantastic tour guide with extensive knowledge on the history and details about the Vatican and surrounding area. She also gave a more personal description of many of the artworks and religious artifacts. Her detailed description more than once brought me and my wife to tears. Without her, the tour would have been a walk through a beautiful location. With her help, we took a beautiful journey through a wonderful spiritual location.

Anna our tour guide was very accommodating and super knowledgeable. This tour is only 3 hours long, we didn't want to spend all day in Vatican City so this tour was perfect. We saw the Sistine Chapel, St. Peter's Basillica, and Vatican Museums then we were allowed to hang around as long as we wanted. We skipped the long lines outside and at St. Peter's. With headsets included you could always hear Anna's knowledgeable voice. As a bonus she referred us to the Canadian work depicting the struggles of immigration by Kitchener Ontario's Timothy Schmalz. Would definitely recommend!!

A phenomenal, highly informative tour led by the incredible Elaine. Full of incredible and uniquely tailored details provided by one of the most passionate, exceptional individuals I have ever had the pleasure of meeting. I work in the hospitality industry and when individuals of the ethos, character and charisma that Elaine brings to the table, happen upon my way I seize them in no time. This one is a star. Thank you Elaine for transmitting your innate passion for art, history and culture in such an effectively effervescent manner. Hugs from Greece.

What a wonderful tour! We had Elaine as our tour guide, and she was FANTASTIC! Best tour guide to see all of the sights. The tour started 10:30am and covered; the Vatican museum, Sistine Chapel, and St. Peter’s Basilica. Our tour was about 3.5hrs and we got to see so many highlights of the museum. Also, skipping the giant (I repeat GIANT) line waiting to get into the Vatican was worth it. Bring a water bottle with you (can refill as you go). There were a lot of people there and it can be crowded sometimes. Make sure to cover your shoulders and knees or you may have to get a covering. Overall it was a great tour, lots of walking but absolutely worth it! Thanks Elaine for being so wonderful!

What a life Tours are so professional, friendly and well organised. 5 star to this company. We absolutely loved our tour Guide John, we did not want the tour to end at the Vatican, Sistine Chapel and St.Peter’s.

Amazing tour! We absolutely LOVED our tour guide, Elaine - she was our favorite guide on all of our various tours we did all throughout our two week trip in Italy. She was hilarious, engaging, and extremely knowledgeable. We would have loved to have her on other tours throughout Rome. She made the Vatican museum so exciting, and I felt like she provided so much information that we would not have received with anyone else. Her passion was contagious. Definitely recommend this tour, and specifically Elaine :)

Vatican: Early Entry to Museums, Sistine Chapel & St Peter's

We met our Guide (Lucia) at a Cafe’ one block away from the Vatican City, and once gathered our headphones, we started to walk towards the entrance.
Lucia, was just marvellous, made everyone feel at ease, and gave us a tour which was a walk through history. Her knowledge is extraordinary, all the anecdotes were a joy to listening to, and full of little details which, no one could find in the numerous books about this splendid building.

The history of St. Peter is the history of the world as we know it, with dramas and love and hate, with power and riches beyond our imagination.
Dynasties and powerful families (normally Italian, but not always) filling our minds with images of intrigues, lies, trades, countries and empires, fighting for control over the pilgrims and their faith.

My partner and I have been all over the world, but seldom we have encountered a more likeable, knowledgeable and friendly Tour Guide.
If in Rome, you should try to get Lucia as your guide, and believe me, you will count yourself lucky as she will make your visit to the Vatican an unforgivable voyage into history.

Great English speaking guide who made things simple because of his good grasp of routes around the vast area. His enthusiasm and knowledge ensured we picked up on stories of the artists which brought the tour alive. You can become satiated by the art as there is so much to see but this helped keep my interest and create lovely memories. You will only do it once.. this way you will see everything others may miss. Well worth it.

Our guide Daniella was wonderful. She was very knowledgeable and answered all of my questions. Skipping the line was so nice as the line was really long. St Peters was beautiful and we happened to be there during a mass. I felt a little rushed through the museum but it was actually fine because it was crowded and very hot. The Sistine Chapel was amazing. We had roughly 10-15 min on our own inside. I recommend this tour.

The meeting point for this tour was extremely easy to find. We had an Italian/Greek lady as our giode and it was only her third time giving the tour in English. The tour lasted about three and a half hours and was really comprehensive.

When we were queuing outside the Basilica waiting to go through security our guide talked the whole time. It was about a 25 minute wait but you didn’t notice it because you were engrossed in what she was saying. I noticed that this was not the case watching other guides and their parties and I felt very fortunate that our guide was so passionate.

We weren’t able to climb up the steps on this day as it was the day of Acension, but that’s fine these things happen. The Vatican Museum was extremely busy but our guide stayed close throughout.

Overall I really enjoyed the tour and would recommend it to anyone especially with this lovely guide. Such a lovely lady.

The tour was outstanding. I’m also super happy because this was my husband’s first time in Rome and I wanted everything to go perfectly-the tour did not disappoint! The tour guide, Eugene, was fun, energetic, and kept us all mesmerized-quite a feat given the length of the tour! We had a great group (only 9 people) and Eugene was really good a reading when the group was interested in something and when it was time to move to the next spot. Would recommend this tour to anyone and everyone!

We opted for a private tour which was TOTALLY worth it! Lucia was a great guide with lots of knowledge to offer. She spent extra time with us describing the importance and meaning behind some of the art collections. The business was incredibly accommodating and waited for the two of us to eat our lunch before the tour began. Lucia stayed beyond the 3-hour tour to show us one last thing in St. Peter’s Basilica.
Overall I would recommend this company and would highly suggest the private tour!

From booking, to the communication to the actual tour it was very good.
Tonia was extremely nice and knowledgeable. She gave us lots of information, which was very helpful.
We weren’t expecting to do St Peters Basilica first and we’re a little shocked at the long queue for security. However this moved very quickly and WOW once inside OMG!! This is one place you do not want to miss!! Tonia gave us lots of information about all the statues and tombs!
Vatican Museum and Sistine Chapel, both very good - apart from ignorant people chatting and trying to take pictures - when clearly you are not allowed.
My personal preference would have done VM and SC first, then St Peters as would have been nice to have had more time.
Just means now need to come back

We had Elaine as our tour guide. She was brilliant. So knowledgeable. It was basically a 4 hour lecture....in the nicest sense......she really did know her stuff.
She admitted she was geeky about the History of Rome and she was extremely thorough and wide ranging in her delivery.
She also had a really good sense of humour and her descriptive powers were thoughtful and well measured.
She made the tour so much more than a walk around some very old stuff!
A pleasure to be in her company for the whole time.

my tour guide was so great! She had so much knowledge of everything you needed to know & was refreshing to hear it. You get to see the museum before reaching The Sistine chapel was everything you can imagine and worth the trip. After you get to see st peters and can reenter after the tour at no charge if you need more time.

Recently (May 2022) booked a tour of the Vatican and was hosted by Elaine. She was vey knowledgeable, helpful and entertaining with a good sense of humour! She helped make a four hour walk around the Vatican pass as though it was only an hour. Her insight into the history of Rome was great and I left having learnt a lot about the city and the Vatican itself.

We toured with Manuela and loved every minute of it. She is intelligent, and entertaining and answered all questions. We could have easily spent days listening to her talk about the art and the history. We will be using this company again and recommending it to all of our friends

St. Peter’s Basilica was fantastic. We had sufficient time to walk around, look at every part, and take pictures. Do not miss this on any trip to Rome.

The Vatican museum was far too crowded to have a positive experience. Thousands of people herded through long corridors without any chance of actually looking at the beautiful and interesting displays.

The Sistine Chapel is wonderful, but unfortunately it is at the end of the museum walk. It was also very crowded and filled with exhausted people trying to find space on the benches to sit. I wish we had the space and time to truly see the chapel.

Our tour guide was great. Very knowledgeable and had a strong desire to keep us informed.

This tour was incredible and so was our tour guide Anna! We saw St Peter’s basilica first which was an excellent starting point, then we went to the Vatican, and then we ended with the Sistine chapel. Anna was very passionate and excited about everything she showed us which really helped make the experience come to life. She had a great personality, made jokes, and kept the pace quick without being too fast and she also gave us options to continue separately at Vatican for more if we wanted. Anna also timed it perfectly so we could see the changing of the Swiss guards which was really cool! she also let us stop and take pictures if we needed to. If there was one suggestion I had it would be to add the ability to climb to the top of Saint peter‘s basilica if possible. For tourists, you need to bring a specific type of mask and must wear in all facilities. We didn’t realize this so luckily at the meeting point, which is a café, they sold the masks we needed and everything was fine. But it’s best to bring your own. Both my husband and I had a really great time on this tour and highly recommend!

This was an amazing tour and special thank you to Eugene, he was spectacular!

I would definitely recommend the earlier tour so you can get into St. Peter's Basilica early when it's less crowded. St. Peter's really is the highlight of this tour. Seeing the Sistine Chapel was cool but the Basilica really blew it away.

Carlotta was a wonderful and extremely knowledgeable guide for our tour, which was an excellent balance in time between the jaw-dropping Basilica and the Vatican. There were several times where her "boss" would appear and tell her to hurry up, which was unfortunate, as Carlotta was a wealth of interesting information and stories. We were "lucky" to experience the tour during COVID – the tradeoff of having to wear masks the entire time was offset by the manageable crowds.
I would highly recommend the tour, but I honestly cannot imagine it with double or triple the crowds!

100% recommend Manuela . She was amazing as are tour guide . We skipped the queues and went straight to the front , nothing was too much trouble . She was patient and caring while waiting around for everyone . she was extremely knowledgeable and would recommend this tour to anyone , it’s a really small group , there was only about 10 of us which is perfect . The office is easy to find just off a side street from the Vatican City . Plus there are a few small cafes where you can grab a coffee while your waiting

An amazing place made even more special by the wonderful Elaine. Knowledgeable and passionate it was a pleasure to have her talking in our ears the entire time. I would definitely recommend and if you are lucky enough, you may end up with Elaine the all knowing as your guide.

Visit to the Vatican City… amazing! We are so pleased we had the opportunity to go to Rome and visit the Vatican City including the Cistine Chapel and St Peter’s Square. Our tour guide Michael was so nice and knowledgable, he made a great effort to make our experience informative and memorable. Thank you!

Elaine was a brilliant guide, super sense of humour, made the tour so interesting and fun, thoroughly recommend it. It was definitely worth having a smaller group. Elaine managed to keep my teenage son engaged for 3.5 hours with her really interesting commentary, no mean feat!

We had an amazing experience with Lucia R. She was extremely knowledgeable and made it a fun learning experience. In the 3 hours we spent together we really saw and learned a lot about Vatican and some world history. Would highly recommend “what a life tours” and especially Lucia R!

Tour guide was very knowledgeable and knew all the tricks to make our tour fascinating and enjoyable. Navigating the museums and St Peters is tricky and having an experienced guide was very helpful. Her stories and insights were memorable

I wouldn’t recommend to do the Vatican without a guided tour and the tour with Anna was great. She is very knowledgeable, adapted the explanations to the audience and a lot of fun. It is enough time and not too much at the end you can stay more. No hidden costs as well

I went on this tour with my husband, 8 month old son and our stroller 😅 We had the absolute pleasure of having Eugene as our tour guide - HE IS THE BEST!!!!!! He was funny, extremely knowledgeable and passionate, accommodating and just a genuine person. He kept us all engaged and taught us so many things. We truly enjoyed our tour because of Eugene. Thanks Eugene!!!!

We just did this tour this morning and it was phenomenal. Elaine was our tour guide and she was outstanding, she knew everything plus a couple amazing facts I would never have learned otherwise. We learned so much I wouldn’t even bother seeing these places without a guided tour by Elaine, I can’t say enough about how wonderful she was!! Without a doubt worth your money! :)

Our tour today on August 26, 2022 by Eugene was just amazing! He was fun, engaging, extremely knowledgable. The tour started on time and ended in a good amount of time, it was not too long nor too short. We did not feel rushed at all.

Our trip consist of four people, my husband, me and our friends, another couple. This was our first time in Rome. The three of us are Catholic but my husband is not, though he enjoyed the tour as much as we did. The art, the sculptures, they were all so amazing.

I strongly recommend to go do this skip the line in the morning and ask for Eugene if you can.

Amazing tour with Elaine. We had the absolute best time with the best tour guide!! Elaine was absolutely fantastic from her knowledge about Vatican City to having a tasteful sense of humor to making the most of our time on the tour. Cannot recommend highly enough. You will not be disappointed. Ask for Elaine!!

We had an amazing experience! Elaine was our tour guide - she clearly is highly knowledgeable and passionate about the history and art within the Vatican. The group was very small (8 ppl) and we were early so we avoided the big crowds. Highly recommend!

This tour is a must! You seriously cannot beat it! What a Life Tours is extremely organized and their staff truly go above and beyond. Joseph was awesome with communicating days prior to the tour with information and directions on the meet up spot and Tonia was the best tour guide I could ask for! She was incredibly knowledgeable and her personality was so delightful. My group ended up being only 6 people and being that I went on Holy Saturday, I could not have asked for a better outcome. I learned so much history and am so grateful for Tonia making it an unforgettable experience. Thank you thank you thank you!! Will definitely come back with my family & friends!

Our tour guide - Elaine - was absolutely lovely. Without her, we would have been completely lost! She had a wealth of information and was clearly very enthusiastic and passionate about the Vatican Museums and history as a whole. The Museums themselves were very interesting, especially when you are learning the history behind the different sculptures, paintings, and artefacts along the way. Definitely recommend!

Loved this tour. Elaine, our guide, did an incredible job the entire time. Her experience and dedication really showed as she navigated our group of 3 through, giving detailed information, facts and answering our questions along the way. Highly recommend this tour, and very worth any extra cost to do a smaller group rather than a larger group.

My husband, and I booked a last-minute Vatican Tour with What a Life Tours, we couldn’t be more happy of our choice! Manuella was amazing, being in small group made the difference
to navigate easily the maze of the Vatican Museums. We have chosen this company, because of the excellent reviews, highly recommended!

A special thanks to Maria, amazing customer care! My husband forgot his phone in a taxi, she promptly called the company, and with our great suprise we found delivered the phone in our hotel. Maria texted us in the evening to make sure we got it! Thank you!!!

Our tour guide Elaine was great. She provided us with a wealth of information about the artists and art throughout the Vatican, Sistine Chapel and St Peter’s Basilica. She also kept us entertained with her humor and vast knowledge.

Our guide Michele made this tour an absolute blast for us and it amazed me how many amazing information he knew about everything. This tour was a highlight of.our trip and an unforgettable experience and I very recommend a small.group of 10-12 people as with so many other groups doing this in parallel it's so much faster and much much better. We'll.done and thank you Michelle again, we.loved your passion for Rome and its history

Ana our tour guide was incredible. She conveyed such enthusiasm all along the tour. Her history and storytelling were wonderful. The crowds were overwhelming but you always felt you were in good hands with Ana!!!

Also, unlike other tours on this trip, the balance between the museum, the Sistine Chapel and the Basilica was l’erede to.

My wife and I were hoping to find a small tour that give structure and depth to such an imposing set of buildings.

Elaine did a magnificent job of making the visit fun, educational, and easy to appreciate everything we were seeing. She was terrific and pointed pieces of history we would walked right past without ever seeing.

Five stars!

We had a wonderful time on our tour! Our tour guide Elaine was fantastic, I felt like we were walking around with our really smart friend. We saw all of the famous works of art and even more smaller significant pieces too that were a bit “off the main drag.” We had a lovely time and learned so much, worth every penny and then some! Fantastic customer service from booking until the end of the tour!!

Excellent tour by Manuella, she was very knowledgeable and personable.
We saw a few key spots on the Vatican tour but generally flew through that specific portion.
If you have any expectations of seeing anything other than the Gallery of Maps, Gallery of Tapestries and a few glimpses of the sculptures, this is not the right tour for you.
The Raphael Rooms and other such treasures are not included.

We had an amazing tour from Tony around the Vatican museum, Sistine Chapel and St Peters Basilica. He was very friendly and welcoming, always made sure no one was left behind and extremely knowledgable. He gave us plenty fun facts about the Vatican and it’s history, and referenced them in the architecture as we continued the tour. Tony made sure we got all the photos we wanted and also offered to take some in the basicila for us. Definitely will be using this tour company again if we visit Rome in the future!

Forgive the delay in getting this posted, but I wanted to tell you how enjoyable my Vatican Early Access Tour was with Ana on October 31, 2019. Ana’s advice about touring the Gallery first was excellent! We saw the entire collection and then proceeded to the Sistine Chapel. Thus, we could appreciate the artwork in both areas with minimal, manageable crowds. Wonderful, too, was her knowledge of Vatican history, selected artworks of note, even the flooring. She described each artifact with interesting facts, and drawing into the history of how each piece reached the Vatican. THANK YOU!

A very informative and beautiful tour. Marco, our guide, is very knowledgeable and personal. He mixed information and humor into the tour. I will say, if you want to stand and admire the works of art, then this tour could be a little too quick for you, but for us it was the right mix of pace.

Our guide was Elaine and she was phenomenal. Very knowledgeable and informative but so much more than that. She kept our group engaged the entire time with her stories, her enthusiasm, and her infectious energy. Very thoughtful, too, as she steered the group to quieter and shadier spots for longer discussions. Words don’t adequately describe how much she added to the overall experience.

Michele was such a wonderful tour guide. Warm, knowledgeable, funny. He also either truly still enjoys seeing the awe on first timer’s faces, or he’s an excellent actor too. Thoroughly meant to meet up with him at the end of the tour to express our thanks, but got lost in the wonder of the the sistine chapel and missed the 15 minute mark. Grazie, Michele!

Nice walking tour in Vatican district. Skip the line option is really useful. We didn't stay in lines at all.
Sistine Chapel is beautiful. We saw Michelangelos original frescoes like Creation of Adam, Creation of Eve, Fall and Expulsion from Garden of Eden.

Elaine, our tour guide, was excellent. She is extremely organised, knowledgeable and pointed out lots of things that could easily have been missed including her secret discoveries. A lovely lady with a cracking sense of humour. Would highly recommend Elaine and this tour. Be mindful that on this tour there are many steps. Richard & Nicola from Nottingham, England.

This is the perfect tour for a first-time Vatican visitor. You get to see it all, but also get insights and context about what you are looking at. Our guide, Eugene, was incredible! So knowledgable and clearly very proud of the art and history we saw on this tour. I would highlight recommend this tour to anyone looking for a beginner's guide to the area.

The museum was packed. More than usual because of the New Years eve schedule with early closing, but our guide Matteo was prepared and very excited about sharing all his knowledge about Vatican City and Michelangelo and all the artist's work. Learned so much in short time! And skip the line and being in a small group of 12 was totally worth it !

This tour was worth it! Navigating the Vatican without the background info provided by our guide would have been a lot less interesting! Skip the line was helpful as well. The only thing that I didn’t like was a stop for background info between parts of the museum. When traveling, it’s good to keep going rather than stand in one place for an extended period. I think this was more related to entry timing at the Vatican rather than the tour operator. It was very hot and our stop was outside. Other than that one issue, the tour was really good. Recommend!

Worth every penny! This tour was amazing; fun, detailed, knowledgeable and jam packed with extra nuggets - 10 minutes in the Basilica gift shop, changing of the Swiss Guard, embalmed popes, ancient graffiti. Elaine was superb - I think she might be the hardest working guide in Rome. We fitted so much into the tour, kept to time and saw loads. Thank you for including St. Peter's Basilica and the explanation of the sistine chapel with visual guide. The radios made it easy to hear Elaine as we wondered round the great cathedral and the museum - meaning we never missed a thing. She even knew loads about the enforced detour through the Etruscan rooms!

Although our planned entry time was changed the quality of Elaine's tour more than overcame it. At the end we could not believe 4 hours gad passed. Queues aren't too bad at the moment, but it's still worth prebooking a skip the line tour to get a bit of space and not waste time queueing, and if you do book this one.

We were lucky on numerous accounts with this tour. Firstly it was the first weekend of warm nights weather and clear skies. Secondly our group of up to 12 became my fiance, myself, and Marco - Marco was our local tour guide who made the entire experience.

Communication from the tour company was excellentd, sending text message with exact location of meeting point and upon arrival we received a warmetSz. S welcome, a free coffee ,and bottle of water each.

Marco gave us an overview of the afternoons plans and we set off.

Listening to Marco talk about Rome, the Vatican, and it’s history was mesmerising. His passion for the subject is immeasurable and salient. It was clear from the start that Marco was not delivering a rehearsed speech but was talking from his heart.

Skipping the queue was handy, however we spent some time queuing for St Peter’s Basilica and the time was filled with even more of Marco’s knowledge.w

I have been to Rome once before & did this tour with another company. Being able to compare both i have to say what a life was much better. Our tour guide, Gabriel was basically google for the Vatican. He kept us informed, laughing and on pace. We saw the highlights and some things that Gabriel thought were important to see.

The only low light of the tour was after the sistine chapel 4 of our tour-mates disappeared. Gabriel went looking for them for about ten minutes while we waited for him to come back. He did not find them so we continued with the tour of st peters and what a sight to behold that was. We even got access to the dome because of Gabriels connections.

I recommend this tour and ask for this amazong tour guide, but dont ghost on your tour-mates. Its very rude.

Best tour company in Rome! They’re very easy to work with and their English is excellent. The tour office located one block away from the Vatican City Walls and is very easy to find.

BIG THANK YOU TO LUCIA, our amazing and very knowledgeable tour guide. I have been wanting to visit the Vatican museums and the Sistine Chapel since I was a little boy. She answered all of my questions without hesitation. She must have a background in art history or teaching because Lucia was simply amazing.

I will be recommending this tour to everyone that goes to Rome.

(Tips for this booking:
1. Make sure you wear an outfit that is covering your shoulders and knees, or you will not be allowed inside within the Vatican Walls.
2. Pay attention to the parts of the tour where photos are not allowed.
3. Be respectful within the Sistine Chapel. No one is supposed to be talking.)

The only thing we had trouble with was finding the group to start, however we called the number given and was greeted by a man who took us to our small group. Tony was sooooo lovely, he immediately introduced himself and us to the other 10 people. He was so informative an incredibly knowledgeable guy. Spoke lovely and clear, no questions were not answered. He gave us time to take photos and even offered to be cameraman if you wanted any taken. Tony set the bar high for other tour companies. Just loved it and highly recommend!! xxx

This is a mixed review. I am giving it 5 stars because this is rating the tour guide and how the presented the tour. It was so crowded in the Vatican, hard to hear the guide because of the amount of people and was incredibly hot. Of course all of these things were not the tour guides fault. Our guide was Costanza (sp?) and we really enjoyed her - very knowledgeable and personable. Unfortunately it was a small group and half the group was a family that was quite demanding and hard for everyone else on the tour to deal with. I won’t go into all the details but they left before St Peter’s and everyone left commented how nice that was! She handled that the best she could.

For the sights - of course anyone going to Rome is going to see the Vatican but here are some things to know. As I said it is VERY crowded. A skip the line tour is a must. Cover knees and shoulders but wear something light.

I actually started enjoying the tour starting with the Sistine Chapel. Right after you go to St. Peter’s which was BEAUTIFUL! Do not skip that part. On the hour the Pope’s guards change shifts. Was cool to see. If you are facing St Peters it is on the left. They come out a side door, not under the tunnel so position yourself accordingly.

The trip description did not indicate there would be considerable walking distance between St. Peter’s and the Vatican. For those who struggle with walking distance with no break, you must consider a different tour. Our guides, however, went above and beyond to accommodate us on the fly and we were able to make it work. The tour itself was fantastic from the choice of meeting point through the end. If you struggle with heat I would recommend a different time of year but would certainly recommend this tour!

This tour is well worth the money! Elaine's knowledge and enthusiasm really helped us to appreciate the treasures were looking at. She made every effort to make sure the tour went perfectly and there were no "gaps" where we simply followed a silent from one place to the next. The Vatican was good too : )

Daniella was our tour guide and was brilliant. She also smartly planned everything so we made it in to the basilica before the crowds. She was so knowledgeable. The private tour was worth every penny as we were able to get jump ahead of other groups, plus Daniella was able to focus on our interests and questions and go at our pace. Can’t recommend What a Life Tours more highly!

We were absolutely thrilled with our tour with Carlotta. Her knowledge was exceptional and she shared the story of each part with passion and enthusiasm which was infectious.
My teenage children were completely engaged throughout and there was time to take photographs.
I thoroughly recommend this company but in particular the guide Carlotta.

This was an amazing tour! If you’re planning to see these places, joining a tour is way easier to navigate through it. It is absolutely bustling with crowds ALL the time. He was knowledgeable and informative and provided interesting anecdotes along the way. He made sure we had the full experience and knew how to navigate through the crowds with as much ease as humanly possible, we enjoyed it very much!

I’m tempted to never book another tour in my life because no one can compare to Elaine. I requested her specifically after reading so many positive reviews about her, and she did not disappoint. You could tell this wasn’t just a job to her, and that she was passionate about what she was teaching us and it made the tour that more enjoyable. 10/10 recommend

This tour from start to end was brilliant. Everything that was said actually happpened.

Directions to their office was great and it even has a toilet available before you set off. (This matters when your drinking a lot of water)
The size of our group was small as advertised and our tour guide Danielle was perfecto. She really knew everything there was to know about the tour as well as taking us straight to the front of every line.
I had read numerous reviews from every operator to try and help decide which company to go with and I’m so glad I chose this one. We skipped all the queues, we weren’t rushed at all and everything was really well explained to us.
I took a lot of little videos throughout the tour to remember it all (except the Sistine Chapel of course) and while filming I was repeating the facts and interesting things Danielle was explaining to us via my earpiece.

If you are first timers to Rome like we are then I would totally recommend this tour with Danielle at What a Life Tours.

This tour was absolutely perfect! Our tour group was small, which was a great idea since it's unbelievably crowded at the Vatican. Our guide Jad was very funny and understanding with every little bump along the road, while also being very informative. I highly recommend a smaller group rather than a large one.

Gabriel was amazing in this tour, he went over and above to show us many things. His knowledge was excellent! He was engaging and passionate and we found the tour so informative and fascinating. He spent the perfect amount of time at every point and pointed out things we would never have noticed. Thank you Gabriel! 10/10!

Definitely have to do this tour when you’re in Rome. Don’t even think about trying to walk around the Vatican & museums by yourself. The exhibits are breathtaking, and without a guide it would take so long to see and understand the most special pieces. Our guide was so efficient and knowledgeable, and moved us quickly through all of the museums. 3 hours seems like a long time but our guide told us that a study showed it would take 48 hours to see every single artifact/piece for just 5 seconds each, so 3 hours is really nothing. Wear comfortable shoes!

We arrived at the meeting point which was a good distance from St. Peter's/Vatican. I booked the tour for our party of 6 which included 3 seniors, 1 with a walker. There is nothing in the tour description to indicate that they would have difficulty or would not be accommodated. Our tour guide was clearly put out with being given a party including older visitors. She took off walking at a brisk pace and never bothered to speak with us except when we asked a question. We toured St. Peter's first. Instead of giving us detailed instructions, she pointed to a door and told us to go there for the elevator. We went in and had to find a guard to give us access to the elevator. When we arrived at the top, we couldn't find the group. Fortunately, we sent 2 of our party with the tour guide and they called me to give me instructions on where to go. We then had to figure out how to leave the building and get through security in order to walk to the Vatican. It was very arduous. Of course, we received absolutely no help from the guide.

We then had to walk a long distance to get to the Vatican entrance. The tour guide took off walking again at a quick pace. When I asked her to slow down, I was told that she had the other 4 guests (not in our party) to attend to. The seniors were exhausted and out of breath when we got to the entrance. We would have called for a taxi had we known the distance. We received absolutely no help or instructions on how to get through security. Fortunately, we did have the tickets. The tour guide did point us to the elevators again when we got through but gave no instruction on where to meet. We were able to find them at the top and did enjoy part of the tour. We were unable to do part of the tour due to stairs. The tour guide did tell us a point where to meet, where we waited 45 minutes. Again, had we known, we could have taken a bathroom break. I was quite appalled at the lack of sympathy or consideration for my senior family.

We were very impressed with the service of What a Life Tours. The time of our tour changed slightly due to changes at the basilica entrance, so the company emailed, texted, and even called us the day before to make sure we knew about the change. The tour group was nice and small, and our guide (I think his name was Eugene) was excellent - entertaining, friendly, knowledgeable, and went above and beyond. He even took us into the basement of the basilica, though that wasn't included on the tour. The museum, Sistine chapel, and St. Peters Bacilica are well worth seeing! Amazing tour!
We had an amazing time and the best tour guide possible. Elaine was so much fun and it really felt like she knew everything there was to know. I highly recommend this tour and Elaine herself.

Spent a wonderful morning with Elaine as we toured Vatican City. Elaine was funny and smart and deeply knowledgeable. Hard to imagine experiencing this wonderful place without someone like Elaine. This tour is highly recommended and the small group approach is worth paying a bit more than the competition.

This was a great tour! Exceeded expectations. Our guide was a fountain for information and funny too. He tested our knowledge in a fun way as we went along and I learned a lot. He got us to the important spots in an efficient way too, which is nice because otherwise you could spend weeks wandering. I also like that after the tour we had the option to explore whatever else we liked on our own! I can’t remember our guides name but he was great. Thank you!

Elaine was a fantastic guide for this tour. She was enthusiastic, knowledgeable, fun, and very engaging. Having the small group was great and we were able to see many pieces of the Vatican Museums practically by ourselves (only 4 people in the Raphael rooms? Unheard of!)

Elaine was obviously very passionate about the pieces, and was knowledgeable even about particular statutes and things that weren't necessarily on her 'highlights' plan - when asked, she still always knew the answer and had an insightful bit of history to share. Would definitely recommend her to anyone.

Our Tour guide Simone (guy) was Amazing! He was charming, funny, informative and very knowledgeable. He was also very honest and forthcoming with answers especially to my young daughter who wanted to know many things. I highly recommend doing this tour.

Knowledgable tour guide who was passionate about the Roma history made this a great tour. Downside was that we had to rush through most of the museum and couldn’t renter with our ticket. We did return to St. Peter’s basilica which does not require an entry ticket. The email announcing the location to meet could include a picture.

Our tour was the day after Easter Monday (a national holiday in Italy), so a Tuesday morning. We were notified a day or two earlier that St Peter's was opening late (about 12:30), so our tour would extend late to allow us to see it, making it a nearly 6 hour tour. We knew they didn't control when the basilica opened, so we all agreed to stay late. We were fortunate that our guide Mario asked us if we would like to tour the Sistine Chapel first or later on. We of course said first, and so we were able to enjoy it without hordes of crowds. We saw some parts of the endless museums associated with the Vatican, and had a break mid-morning in the Vatican cafeteria. After that break the Vatican was so busy it was nearly impossible to walk through any galleries. We could hear Mario through our headsets but literally were shoulder to shoulder with hordes of people and could not stop at all to explore the art. After a while, Mario directed us back to the Sistine Chapel, which leads the way to the Basilica entrance. It was completely jammed and we were so thankful we toured it earlier in relative peace. Early access to the Vatican should standard decision in my book!! As we made our way down to the Basilica entrance it appeared it was not open and we would not be allowed access by the guards. We went outside and saw a tremendously long line of people who had been in line all morning to enter the Basilica. Of course, we could not get in, having already left the Vatican and losing the opportunity to enter the Basilica via the Vatican. It was extremely disappointing, as seeing St Peter's is one of the key highlights of touring the Vatican! Mario was very disappointed on our behalf, but there was nothing to be done. Lesson learned: do not book travel to the Vatican anywhere around a religious holiday, even a few days after. Mario was an entertaining and informative guide - I don't know if he had the ability to take us to less crowded parts of the Vatican museums - if yes, it would have been more enjoyable, but perhaps the guides are limited to where they can take tour groups, as there were many around us. What a Life Tours did offer everyone in our group a free pass to an evening walking tour of Rome, but at that point we had all our plans in place and the timing wasn't right. In general, I would recommend this company in the future, but definitely plan your visit as far from religious holidays as possible to really guarantee you get into the basilica.
